correctness.rationale: For any fixed lattice frame, the minimal cube translate radius for a simplex is half its maximum coordinate prefix range. Over all permutations that range equals max(P_i,N_i), the positive/negative integer row sums. Invertibility forces every row nonzero. Radius 1/2 iff each row is a signed coordinate row or difference of two coordinate rows; incidence with d+1 labeled vertices gives exactly a connected d-edge graph, hence a tree. Leaf expansion shows determinant +/-1; Prüfer coding, orientations and row labels yield precisely 2^d(d+1)^(d-1) unordered frames. Independent enumeration found 2,12,128 minimizers for d=1,2,3; all-dimensional conclusion is the incidence proof.
